name: Bands
summary: This is a Bollinger Bands indicator implementation for MetaTrader 5, not an Expert Advisor. It calculates and displays the upper, middle, and lower Bollinger Bands on the chart based on a specified period and deviation multiplier, serving as a technical analysis tool for identifying overbought and oversold conditions.
summary_zh: 这是一个布林带指标实现，而非EA交易程序。它根据指定周期和偏差倍数计算并显示上轨、中轨和下轨布林带，作为技术分析工具用于识别超买超卖状态。
strategy_analysis: 该文件是一个布林带技术指标而非自动交易EA，因此不具备自动入场和出场逻辑。布林带中轨通常为简单移动平均线(SMA)，上下轨为中轨加减N倍标准差。交易者可手动根据价格触及上轨做空、触及下轨做多来实现均值回归策略。该指标本身不包含仓位管理和资金管理功能，仅提供可视化参考。标准差倍数和周期参数允许用户调整带的宽窄和灵敏度。作为纯指标工具，它不执行任何交易操作，风险完全取决于使用者的手动决策。
strategy_analysis_en: This file is a Bollinger Bands technical indicator rather than an automated trading EA, so it does not contain automatic entry and exit logic. The middle band is typically a simple moving average (SMA), with upper and lower bands set at N standard deviations above and below. Traders can manually implement mean reversion strategies by selling when price touches the upper band and buying when it touches the lower band. The indicator itself does not include position sizing or money management features, providing only visual reference. The deviation multiplier and period parameters allow users to adjust band width and sensitivity. As a pure indicator tool, it executes no trades and risk depends entirely on the user's manual decisions.
pros: 经典技术指标，理论基础扎实，广泛应用于各类市场
参数可调，用户可根据不同品种和周期灵活配置
作为独立指标不执行交易，不会造成资金风险
pros_en: Classic technical indicator with solid theoretical foundation, widely used across markets
Configurable parameters allow flexible adjustment for different instruments and timeframes
As a standalone indicator it executes no trades, eliminating capital risk from the tool itself
cons: 仅提供信号参考，不自动执行交易，需要人工干预
缺乏与交易系统的集成，无法直接用于自动化策略
单一指标信号容易产生假突破，需要配合其他指标使用
cons_en: Only provides signal reference without automatic trade execution, requiring manual intervention
Lacks integration with trading systems, cannot be directly used for automated strategies
Single indicator signals prone to false breakouts, requiring confirmation from other indicators
improvements: 增加多周期布林带联动显示功能
添加报警功能，当价格突破上下轨时发送通知
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe Bollinger Bands synchronization display feature
Add alert functionality to send notifications when price breaks above or below the bands

risk_points: 作为指标本身无交易风险，但使用者若仅依赖单一布林带信号交易可能面临假突破风险
缺乏止损和仓位管理建议，新手可能过度依赖指标信号
risk_points_en: No trading risk from the indicator itself, but users relying solely on Bollinger Band signals face false breakout risk
Lacks stop-loss and position sizing guidance, novice traders may over-rely on indicator signals
